note: Mixed page (filename tag ignored): HEALTH SERVICES then CUSTODIAL SERVICES. School Physician -> district-wide; nurses by printed building (SENIOR HIGH SCHOOL -> high, TURKEY HILL MIDDLE SCHOOL -> turkey-hill, PASSIOS ELEMENTARY SCHOOL -> passios). Barney is on indefinite leave; Lahti retired 12/31/74 and Pace replaced her 12/1/74; both kept. Custodial: 'SYSTEM:' Okerman (Supervisor/Foreman of Buildings & Grounds, replacing Mr. Lemieux) -> district-wide; SENIOR HIGH SCHOOL list (Paton, Ebersole, Gilmour replacing Mr. Juliano, Letarte, Massak) -> high; TURKEY HILL MIDDLE SCHOOL list (Carrier, Abare, Bellafiore, Bishop, Isabelle) -> turkey-hill. This page confirms the 1973 attribution of Letarte and Massak to high and Bellafiore to middle. Bishop resigned 11/1/74 and Isabelle 1/10/75; both kept. Mrs./Dr. dropped.
